name: @hayashiii/sitesnap
description: AI-friendly CLI for capturing website screenshots (desktop + mobile) with sitemap support and per-domain organization. Built for portfolio reference collection.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner="#!/usr/bin/env node" --external playwright --external fast-xml-parser
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build

author: Hayashi <hay@shigoto.dev>
